'''Eskella Gryton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was the daughter of [[Tremel]], an [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of the Sith Academy on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. After [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] killed her father, she tried to avenge him, but was quickly defeated by the Sith Warrior.

==Behind the scenes==
If the warrior chose to spare her father after their inevitable duel, it is possible to avoid a conflict with Eskella by telling her that her father is alive. Regardless of the warrior's advice, she decides to hunt him down, wherever he's hiding. Once she has found him, Tremel will be forced to kill his own daughter, blaming Baras for what he put them both through. The player can choose the dark side option and kill her.
